title: A NOVEL SYNTHESIS OF β-KETO ALKYLATED 1,4-QUINONE
abstract: Abstract                Many β-keto alkylated 1,4-quinones were synthesized facilely by photochemical reaction of 2-methyl- or 2-methoxy-1,4-quinones with 2-methoxy- or 2-trimethylsilyloxy-1-alkenes and subsequent oxidation of the photo-products under acidic conditions.
